QUERY="-- Compute summary statistics for each feature over time windows
WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS day,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(f1) AS avg_f1, STDDEV(f1) AS std_f1, MIN(f1) AS min_f1, MAX(f1) AS max_f1,
    AVG(f2) AS avg_f2, STDDEV(f2) AS std_f2, MIN(f2) AS min_f2, MAX(f2) AS max_f2,
    AVG(f3) AS avg_f3, STDDEV(f3) AS std_f3, MIN(f3) AS min_f3, MAX(f3) AS max_f3,
    AVG(f4) AS avg_f4, STDDEV(f4) AS std_f4, MIN(f4) AS min_f4, MAX(f4) AS max_f4,
    AVG(f5) AS avg_f5, STDDEV(f5) AS std_f5, MIN(f5) AS min_f5, MAX(f5) AS max_f5,
    AVG(f6) AS avg_f6, STDDEV(f6) AS std_f6, MIN(f6) AS min_f6, MAX(f6) AS max_f6
  FROM ${MLPAB_DATABRICKS_PREFIX}_features
  GROUP BY CAST(event_time AS DATE)
),
-- Compare each day to the previous day
comparison AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    -- Feature 1
    ABS(avg_f1 - LAG(avg_f1) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f1) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f1,
    ABS(avg_f2 - LAG(avg_f2) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f2) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f2,
    ABS(avg_f3 - LAG(avg_f3) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f3) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f3,
    ABS(avg_f4 - LAG(avg_f4) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f4) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f4,
    ABS(avg_f5 - LAG(avg_f5) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f5) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f5,
    ABS(avg_f6 - LAG(avg_f6) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / NULLIF(LAG(std_f6) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS z_f6
  FROM daily_stats
)
-- Identify the day with the largest change for each feature
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f1' AS feature,
  z_f1 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f1 = (SELECT MAX(z_f1) FROM comparison WHERE z_f1 IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f2' AS feature,
  z_f2 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f2 = (SELECT MAX(z_f2) FROM comparison WHERE z_f2 IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f3' AS feature,
  z_f3 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f3 = (SELECT MAX(z_f3) FROM comparison WHERE z_f3 IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f4' AS feature,
  z_f4 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f4 = (SELECT MAX(z_f4) FROM comparison WHERE z_f4 IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f5' AS feature,
  z_f5 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f5 = (SELECT MAX(z_f5) FROM comparison WHERE z_f5 IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  day AS onset,
  'f6' AS feature,
  z_f6 AS z_score
FROM comparison
WHERE z_f6 = (SELECT MAX(z_f6) FROM comparison WHERE z_f6 IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY z_score DESC
LIMIT 1"
